Show HN: OpenButterfly – Tracking the environmental impact of the AI ecosystem
items.summary: I built OpenButterfly to help people understand the environmental impact of the AI ecosystem. Openbutterfly tracks major AI companies (AI labs, cloud providers, chip makers and data center operators) and maps data center sites with their local grid carbon and water stress. Every disclosed figure links to the report page it came from. Missing figures show as "not disclosed", and estimates are clearly labeled. A few things surprised me.
